# CLI golden cases whose Go output differs from the C reference by design.
# Format: <case> <id> [comment]; the ids are those of docs/differences.md
# (NaN: option values that upstream accepts with undefined behavior and
# the port rejects, see cmd/fpgrowth/options.go). TestGolden requires a
# difference from testdata/golden and equality with testdata/golden-go.
t1-s0           M2   -s0: no support-0 sets
cluster-Z       O6   -Z statistics after the item sets on stdout
hex-noprefix    O6   (-m0xZ sets -Z)
F-cont          O6   (-F60:50Z sets -Z)
dev-Z-stdout    O6
tm-ev           R4   conviction +Inf for confidence 1
dev-ev-rules    R4
tg-ey           R9   Yates' correction clamped at 0
psp-out         O3   fast output path: wrong pattern spectrum (report B6)
dev-fast-empty  O3   fast output path: spurious empty set
dev-h           O1   -h record header written
dev-g           O2   -g scanable names
dev-d           O10  %d is the absolute support
dev-eb-rules    R1   -tr -eb is the imbalance ratio
dev-S-rules     R8   -tr -S limits the body support
dev-R3          R3   head-only items not in bodies
dev-p           R2   -p filters with the evaluation measure
dev-snan        NaN  rejected: invalid minimum support nan
dev-maxsupp-nan NaN  rejected: invalid maximum support nan
dev-cnan        NaN  rejected: invalid minimum confidence nan
dev-dnan        NaN  rejected: invalid evaluation threshold nan
dev-Fnan        NaN  rejected: invalid support border nan
dev-esc         I1   unknown escape \, stands for ','
dev-esc-end     I1   trailing backslash stands for itself
dev-nonascii    I2   non-ASCII separator bytes
dev-negw        M6   negative weights rejected
dev-bigw        M7   64-bit weights (C crashes)
dev-prefmt      O11  no pre-format table (C crashes in isr_prefmt)
dev-longfield   I4   no 1024-byte field limit
dev-lastsep     I3   final record ending in a field separator kept
dev-recnum      I5   record number in messages
dev-dir         I5   read error names the file
dev-At          M1   -At item map (C crashes)
dev-tg-m2       M3   generators with -m2
dev-tm-pex      M4   maximal set of top-level perfect extensions
dev-tm-x        M9   -tm -x with the 16-items machine
